profile.headline: Software Engineer
profile.summary: I'm a Software Engineer currently working as a freelance software developer. I enjoy learning and working with new and exciting technologies and discovering how they can be implemented in many aspects of daily life. I enjoy both being part of a team that is able to work efficiently as well as getting the opportunity to lead a project. Away from work I like to enjoy the outdoors by going hiking with my family or relaxing at home playing video games. I also enjoy learning new skills, whether that involves new technologies, a new history subject, or playing the bass guitar.

positions.title: Application Developer
positions.description:
- Conducted in-depth analyses of emerging technologies and novel product concepts to assess their readiness and potential utility for Allstate
- Utilized agile methodologies to collaborate with cross-functional teams to define minimum viable products and engaged with product owners to evaluate the viability of new technologies
- Facilitated cross-team collaborations to prepare applications for production deployment
- Communicated findings and insights with the company through presentations and comprehensive white paper reports
positions.insights: Skills: Unit Testing · JavaScript · TypeScript · Knowledge Sharing · Code Review · Android Development · React.js · Knowledge Acquisition

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Wi-Fi Verification
-	Coded an authentication system that would use a web API and mobile application to verify users via the internet
-	Created a RESTful Web API using Java and Spring Boot that would send and receive data in JSON messages
-	Managed user profiles and data using MongoDB and tested output with Postman
-	Created an android application that would receive and send JSON messages and save information locally
-	Encrypted messages using hashing techniques and allow the transfer of data without sending sensitive information through the internet
-	Ensured code predictability through error handling, logging, and keeping up code readability

positions.title: Lead Manufacturing Technician
positions.description:
-	Directed team members daily and delegated resources accordingly
-	Resolved issues and made critical decisions when necessary
-	Handled intra-department/shift communications such as specific instructions and product concerns
-	Reported productivity, inventory, and waste on a daily basis
-	Maintained quality of the product to a high standard through detailed inspections
-	Operated and troubleshooted machinery according to precise specifications
-	Trained new employees on machinery, company standards, and safety regulations

projects.title: GPT2 Comedy Writer
projects.description:
-	Android Application which uses machine learning systems to create jokes by scraping thousands of jokes from Reddit
-	Created in Kotlin using Gradle in the Android Studio environment
-	Increased efficiency by implementing libraries such as OKHTTP3 and TinyDB
-	Implemented functionality to receive the data from an API in JSON format 
-	Returned feedback on each joke to improve the model’s ability to create jokes
-	Coded UI to be user friendly and follow Android Design Standards
-	Developed using TDD and Agile development methodologies
-	Adhered to Pragmatic Programming practices such as loosely coupled methods, maintaining readability, and avoiding duplicate code

projects.title: JVPM (Java Virtual Python Machine)
projects.description:
-	Engineered a Java Virtual Machine while coding in Python
-	Led team in meetings and planning while implementing Scrum Agile development methodologies
-	Examined and implemented the stack architecture of the JVM
-	Defined and tested operations and functions using unit-tests keeping code coverage above 95%
-	Maintained code readability and maintainability using Pylint with a score above 90%
